title: Isorhyncophylline Targets PP2AC to Modulate YAP to Inhibit Endothelial Cell Inflammation.
authors: Wang, Lihua; Liu, Yuecheng; Li, Haichao; Yu, Wenchi; Hu, Yuanlong; Hu, Desheng; Jiang, Haiqiang; Zhu, Xialin; Wang, Danyang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物IRN通过靶向PP2AC调节YAP抑制内皮炎症，涉及分子对接但核心是蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与TF-DNA课题关联弱。
abstract: Atherosclerosis (AS) constitutes the pathological basis of multiple cardiovascular diseases, predisposing to severe clinical complications. Isorhynchophylline (IRN), a principal bioactive alkaloid derived from Uncaria rhynchophylla, exhibits anti-inflammatory properties, yet its therapeutic potential and molecular mechanisms in AS remain unexplored. Scratch wound healing and Transwell migration assays were conducted to evaluate the effects of monomer compounds on cellular migratory and invasive capabilities. The changes in mRNA and protein expression levels of inflammation genes were determined using RT-PCR and western blot analyses, respectively. Molecular docking and drug affinity responsive target stability analyses were performed to assess the binding affinity of IRN and PP2AC. Our findings demonstrate that IRN treatment effectively ameliorates atherosclerotic plaque progression and mitigates endothelial inflammation. The underlying mechanism involves the binding of IRN to PP2AC and the subsequent regulation of YAP activity. This study underscores the therapeutic potential of IRN in alleviating inflammation and its promise as a treatment for AS.
abstract_zh: 动脉粥样硬化（AS）构成多种心血管疾病的病理基础，易诱发严重临床并发症。异钩藤碱（IRN）是从钩藤中提取的主要生物活性生物碱，具有抗炎特性，但其在AS中的治疗潜力及分子机制尚未被探索。通过划痕愈合实验和Transwell迁移实验评估单体化合物对细胞迁移和侵袭能力的影响。利用RT-PCR和western blot分析分别测定炎症基因mRNA和蛋白表达水平的变化。采用分子对接和药物亲和响应靶标稳定性分析评估IRN与PP2AC的结合亲和力。我们的研究结果表明，IRN治疗能有效改善动脉粥样硬化斑块进展并减轻内皮炎症。其潜在机制涉及IRN与PP2AC的结合及随后对YAP活性的调控。本研究强调了IRN在缓解炎症方面的治疗潜力及其作为AS治疗手段的前景。
